verdict.rationale: The axis applies: INPI Portugal runs an online filing flow, and an IP office could publish operating hours, daily limits, or session timeouts for it. No evidence item mentions any such window, limit, or timeout. The pack only lists filing services, the existence of an online filing guide, and in-person appointment scheduling, none of which disclose these constraints.

support.subject: As a founder, any operating-hours window, per-day limit, or session timeout on the online flow is published up front, before I start
